name: Vozvraschenie Krasnoj Shapochki, novye prikljuchenija
source:
This game is a sequel to [url=/v22339]Return of Red Riding Hood[/url]. This time Red Riding Hood and her mom will be baking pastries with ham, sorrel and cottage cheese, while finding themselves again in ridiculous and funny situations.
	
[From [url=https://nlbproject.com/hub/game?name=chaperon_new]official website[/url]]
translation:
本作是[url=/v22339]《小红帽归来》[/url]的续作。这一次，小红帽与妈妈一边制作火腿、酸模和奶酪糕点，一边再次陷入荒谬滑稽的处境。

（来源：[url=https://nlbproject.com/hub/game?name=chaperon_new]官方网站[/url]）
